name: After § 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: 4g. Calls on the Commission to fully enforce all current EU instruments and protective measures in order to respond swiftly, effectively and proportionately to the extraterritorial application of US sanctions and other coercive measures targeting European operators, financial institutions, investors and public or private entities engaged in lawful activities in Cuba; calls on the Commission to modernise the EU blocking statute1a in order to ensure an effective response in that respect; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Council Regulation (EC) No 2271/96 of 22 November 1996 protecting against the effects of the extra-territorial application of legislation adopted by a third country, and actions based thereon or resulting therefrom (ELI:[http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/1996/2271/2018-08-07](http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/1996/2271/2018-08-07)).
